places.name: La Carinderia
places.address: Tourism Rd, Poblacion V, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Italian–Filipino fusion recognized by Tatler; praised for traditional carbonara (guanciale, Pecorino) and ube tiramisu. Friendly staff. Some find salads small for the price. Cash only.

places.name: The Hub by Lokal Lab
places.address: San Sebastian St, Purok 2, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Farm-to-table Filipino food with a community cause; cooking classes and cozy barn-style setting. Slightly away from the tourist strip but consistently called one of the healthiest, freshest meals on the island.

places.name: Bravo Restaurant
places.address: Tourism Rd, Barangay 5, General Luna, 8420 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Spanish-influenced beach resort restaurant; fish tacos, squid-ink paella and peri-peri chicken are favorites, with well-priced cocktails and pool day passes. Service can slow down when packed; on the pricier side.

places.name: NĀGA Siargao
places.address: Tourism Rd (across Callbox), General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Catch-of-the-day fish, Turkish eggs and Filipino breakfasts in an upscale-feeling but relaxed room. Warm, attentive staff; a few find the pasta underseasoned.

places.name: Las Barricas Siargao
places.address: General Luna, Siargao, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Hugely popular Spanish tapas bar built around a live coconut tree; bold flavors, standout tacos, sangria and chocolate cake. Almost always full — arrive early.

places.name: Happiness Restaurant
places.address: Tourism Rd, Catangnan, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Charming hostel restaurant with live bands and grill nights; grilled fish, margaritas and matcha get special mentions. Reviewers rave about the warm staff and reasonable prices.

places.name: Alma Siargao
places.address: Purok 1, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.hours: Daily 5–10 PM; Fri–Sun also 9 AM–2 PM
places.summary: Upscale dining: seafood paella, yellowfin tuna carpaccio and Manchego cheesecake with excellent service. Pricey; reservations recommended; a few report menu items running out.

places.name: Prana Garden Restaurant
places.address: Tourism Rd, Poblacion 3, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Serene garden resort restaurant with pool access (min. spend applies); vegan/vegetarian-friendly bowls, ocean curry and smoothies. Portions run small for the price per some guests.

places.name: Siargao Nomad Cafe & Workspace
places.address: Angelica's Hostel, Tourism Rd, Poblacion 3, General Luna
places.summary: Quiet air-conditioned coworking cafe with fast, reliable wifi and affordable food (shawarma, kinilaw). Entrance is a little hidden.

places.name: SHAKA Siargao
places.address: Cloud 9 Tower, Tourism Rd, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: The island's famous smoothie-bowl and vegetarian breakfast spot with a panoramic view of Cloud 9. Open-air, laid-back, great post-surf recharge.

places.name: Coastal Grounds Coffee
places.address: Pops District, Cloud Nine Dr, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Specialty coffee across from Cloud 9: dialed-in lattes, pourovers and quality beans, plus wifi for working. Repeatedly called the best coffee on the island.

places.name: Brunch Spot
places.address: Barangay 5, Poblacion, General Luna, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Pancakes (a highlight), breakfast burritos, açaí bowls and full Filipino breakfasts; flexible, friendly kitchen. Can get warm inside despite aircon.

places.name: Green Waves Café
places.address: Purok 3, Tourism Rd, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Cozy long-running cafe; creamy truffle chicken pasta, smoothies and a matcha latte some call the island's best. Cards accepted with a 5% fee.

places.name: Ocean and Earth Café
places.address: Poblacion 3, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Small cozy cafe with a beautiful tree inside; tapa rice bowls and fresh ingredients, warm and quick staff.

places.name: White Beard Coffee (GL Branch)
places.address: Poblacion 1, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Popular with locals and visitors alike; huge breakfast portions, waffles, eggs Benedict and its own bakery. Spacious with ample parking, near the GL port.

places.name: Sunset Coffee Roasters
places.address: Tourism Rd (near AFAM bridge), General Luna, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Small specialty roaster near AFAM bridge; matcha/hojicha lattes, toasts and coffee workshops. Dog-friendly, limited seating.

places.name: Eddie's Beach Resort
places.address: Bongayon, General Luna, 8416 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Family-run beachfront resort with exceptionally warm hosts, pool and sunset views. Some guests report aging rooms and inconsistent housekeeping.

places.name: Siargao Seasky Resort
places.address: Brgy. Catangnan (beside Last Chance), General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Budget-friendly base near Tourism Road; clean comfortable rooms, buffet breakfast and pool. Some road noise at night; housekeeping can be inconsistent.

places.name: Bravo Beach Resort
places.address: Tourism Rd, Poblacion 5, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Stylish beach resort with a popular pool and Spanish restaurant; cozy well-designed rooms and warm service. Pool area can get crowded with day guests.

places.name: Siago Beach Resort
places.address: Purok V, General Luna, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: High-end boutique beachfront resort; highly personalized service, beautiful villas, good tours and event setups (anniversaries, brunches).

places.name: Isla Cabana Resort
places.address: Purok 5, Tourism Rd, Brgy. Cambutuanon, General Luna, 8419
places.summary: Polished resort right on Tourism Road: lush grounds, spacious villas (some with private pools), strong breakfast spread and attentive staff. Beachfront villas are pricey.

places.name: Haven Suites Siargao
places.address: Poblacion V, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Newer quiet property, 8-minute walk from the main hub; pool-view rooms, water refills, scooter rental and tours arranged. Simple breakfast; no fridge/TV in rooms.

places.name: Daluyong Beach Resort
places.address: Tourism Rd, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Peaceful oceanfront garden resort with big clean rooms and comfortable pool day passes (₱500 consumable). Wifi could be better; nanny service available.

places.name: Patrick's on the Beach
places.summary: Beachfront bungalows and AC dorms facing Guyam and Daku islands, in the heart of everything. Friendly owner, tours arranged, restaurant shaded under mature trees.

places.name: Siargao Island Villas
places.address: Tourism Rd, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Beachfront pool, varied breakfast, private tuk-tuk shuttle, gym, billiards and table tennis; service repeatedly praised. Garden villas get road noise.

places.name: Ferra Resort Siargao
places.address: Malinao Beach, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Quieter Malinao Beach location ~7 minutes from town; charming spacious huts, pool, new restaurant, and staff who go far beyond expectations.

places.name: Mad Monkey Siargao (Hostel)
places.address: Lot 2903, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: The island's big social/party hostel: nightly events, party boat trips, big beds and a family feel. One recent guest reported a bed-bug incident; most reviews are glowing.

places.name: Kesa Cloud 9 Resort
places.address: Cloud 9 Dr, General Luna, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Directly fronting Cloud 9 — unbeatable surf access that bypasses the boardwalk entrance fee, with free breakfast. Rooms are dated with mixed cleanliness reports.

places.name: Alon Cloud9 Resort
places.address: Tourism Rd (near Cloud 9 boardwalk), General Luna
places.summary: Lush beachfront grounds with boardwalk access; big cozy rooms and famously helpful staff (tours, rentals, surf lessons). Occasional water/utility hiccups reported.

places.name: Cloud 9 Surfing Area
places.summary: The world-famous reef break that made Siargao. Watch surfers take on barrels from the boardwalk and tower, catch sunrise or golden hour. Rocky seabed — beginners should take care and wear booties.

places.name: The Boardwalk at Cloud 9
places.address: Cloud 9 Dr, General Luna, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Siargao's iconic walk over the reef with a viewing tower; best at sunrise for photos, very crowded at sunset. Surfboard rental and lessons available at the entrance.

places.name: The Boardwalk @ The Boulevard
places.address: General Luna waterfront, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: GL's pier area: island-hopping boats to Guyam/Daku/Naked Island leave every morning, plus a market with fresh seafood and fruit, sunset views and karaoke bars.

places.name: Siargao Firefly Watching
places.summary: Magical evening paddle through mangroves among thousands of fireflies, often with bioluminescent plankton glowing blue. Around ₱250–300 per person with a local guide; no booking needed.

places.name: Malinao Beach
places.address: Malinao–Union Rd, General Luna, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Quiet local beach with a skate scene, a 'secret beach' nearby and some of the island's best sunsets. Shallow and seaweedy at times; beach bar open Wed–Sun.

places.name: Bugak Cold Spring
places.address: Sta. Cruz, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Refreshing crystal-clear cold spring with a rope swing, plus kayak rental to explore the mangrove river. Uncrowded, friendly locals, very affordable.

places.name: Tayangban Cave Pool
places.address: Siargao Circumferential Rd, Pilar (en route from GL)
places.summary: Short guided swim through a bat-filled cave ending at a pool with rope swing and jump spot. ~₱260/person incl. guide and helmet; cash only; wear water shoes.

places.name: Surf Coach Siargao SPF
places.summary: Highly rated coaching for all levels led by Allan and team; wave-by-wave feedback, smart spot selection, fast progress. Strict but effective.

places.name: Luna Surf School
places.address: Cloud 9 Dr, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Patient, encouraging instructors near Cloud 9 for beginners through improvers, including boat sessions. Clarify lesson pricing in advance — it varies by spot.

places.name: Harana Surf School
places.address: Harana Surf Resort, Tuason Point, General Luna
places.summary: Structured lessons with theory intro and video analysis, plus multi-day guided trips to breaks around southern Siargao. Handles groups well.

places.name: Discover Siargao (Tours)
places.summary: Local tour operator / info point for island hopping, land tours and activities around Siargao.

places.name: Siargao Wakepark (Sunday Funday)
places.summary: Wakeboarding cable park inland from General Luna; hosts Sunday event sessions.

places.name: NERO Beach
places.address: South of General Luna, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Beach spot listed south of General Luna; little review data available — check locally before making the trip.

places.name: Siargao Pharmacy
places.summary: Central and open late, with friendly staff and supplies for reef cuts. Several reviewers complain prices run well above SRP.

places.name: MOM Pharmacy
places.address: Tourism Rd, Catangnan side, General Luna
places.hours: Mon–Sat 8 AM–10 PM, Sun 9 AM–8 PM
places.summary: Well-stocked OTC range convenient to the Cloud 9 end of town. Mixed reviews on staff friendliness and pricing; double-check items handed over.

places.name: Sam's Pharmacy & Grocery
places.summary: Handy pharmacy + mini-grocery combo near the port; waterproof bandages and basics, reasonable prices. Closed Sundays.

places.name: TGP The Generics Pharmacy
places.address: JFC Commercial Center, Poblacion I, General Luna
places.summary: Best prices in town for generic painkillers and antibiotics, next to Island Doctors on the main road. Posted hours aren't always accurate.

places.name: Lifecheck Pharma
places.address: Poblacion 2, General Luna, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Open late most days. Mixed reviews: some praise fast, well-stocked service; others report being handed the wrong type of remedy — describe symptoms clearly.

places.name: BDO Network Bank + ATMs
places.address: Plaza Business Center, cnr San Sebastian & National Hwy, General Luna
places.summary: The town's main bank: two ATMs (~₱10,000 max per withdrawal) plus USD/EUR exchange at fair rates — bring your passport. Go early to beat queues; machines are down at times.

places.name: Cantilan Bank ATM
places.address: Poblacion, General Luna, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: First bank to open in General Luna; ATM usually stocked (large withdrawals reported possible) but reliability varies — have a backup plan.

places.name: Euronet ATM (Malinao Rd)
places.address: Malinao Rd, General Luna, Surigao del Norte
places.summary: 24-hour Euronet ATM on the Malinao side — useful backup outside town. Expect international-card fees typical of Euronet machines.

places.name: GoTyme Bank Kiosk (POPS District)
places.address: Pops District, Cloud 9 Dr, General Luna
places.summary: GoTyme kiosk at the Cloud 9 end of town for digital-bank services and card pickup.

places.name: GoTyme ATM (Buddha Resort)
places.address: Buddha Resort, Tourism Rd, General Luna
places.summary: 24-hour GoTyme ATM conveniently placed on Tourism Road at Buddha Resort.

places.name: Santos Van for Hire
places.address: Brgy. Catangnan, General Luna (Siargao Transport Service Coop)
places.summary: Punctual van cooperative for airport pickups and island transfers; reviewers call it the best van service on the island.

places.name: Siargao Van For Hire
places.address: Based Sta. Monica; serves the whole island incl. GL
places.summary: Van transfers and scooter rentals; hotels use it regularly for guest pickups. Mostly reliable, though one traveler reported a no-show — reconfirm the night before.

places.name: Siargao Car Rentals
places.summary: Top-rated car hire: clean Suzuki Jimnys delivered to and collected from your hotel, responsive booking, proper insurance options (TPL + damage cover).

places.name: Car Rental Siargao
places.address: Tourism Rd, Poblacion V, General Luna
places.summary: 24-hour car hire office on Tourism Road; little review data yet — contact directly for rates.

places.name: Siargao Rides Hub
places.summary: Cars and real motorcycles (not just scooters — rare on the island); responsive on WhatsApp, hassle-free handover.

places.name: BARREL Beachfront Sports Bar
places.summary: Beachfront sports bar with big screens (UFC mornings!), billiards, darts and draft beer; the shawarma and wraps are big value. Busy at night — tables go fast.

places.name: Hideaway Bar
places.address: Boardwalk, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Boardwalk-view bar with free pool tables, karaoke, arcade and beer pong; hands-on owners and cheap cold beer make it many visitors' nightly go-to.

places.name: Last Chance
places.summary: Craft-cocktail bar with creative local ingredients (calamansi, pandan, tropical fruit), a striking back bar and both AC-indoor and outdoor seating. Widely called the island's best cocktails.

places.name: Siargao Beach Club (SBC)
places.summary: The island's main late-night club and after-party hub: foam parties, fire dancers, four bars, unli-shrimp deals and space to actually dance. Cash and cards accepted.

places.name: Pop Up Bar Siargao
places.address: Jacking Horse beachfront (beside Cafe Kokomo), General Luna
places.summary: Beachfront sunset spot by Jacking Horse with live acoustic music, surfer views and a mellow crowd — a favorite alternative to the busy bridge at golden hour.

places.name: Happiness Beach Bar
places.summary: Swings, bean bags and happy hour right on the sand, with Wednesday trivia nights, good wifi for remote work and pool access for bar guests.

places.name: Kurvada
places.address: Near Tourism Rd (Q5Q6+4WR), General Luna, Surigao del Norte
places.hours: Mon–Fri 10:30 AM–8 PM, Sat to 2 PM (closed Sun)
places.summary: Siargao rite-of-passage: walk the counter, point at the Filipino dishes you want, pay per plate. Very budget-friendly with generous portions and lots of variety; expect queues at dinner and a slightly chaotic ordering line.

places.name: Sapporo Swirl
places.address: Tourism Rd, General Luna, 8419 Surigao del Norte
places.summary: Hokkaido-style soft-serve shop on Tourism Road: creamy, not-too-sweet swirls (pistachio, crème brûlée, even olive oil) with lots of toppings. A medium easily shares between two; seating is limited, lines move fast.

places.name: JM Carenderia
places.summary: Classic point-point eatery with veggie options, a small sari-sari section and a late-afternoon barbecue from ~5:30 PM.

places.name: Carindelia
places.summary: Filipino comfort food praised across the board — bulalo, sisig, bistek, kare-kare — at prices cheaper than most, with fast wifi and outdoor dining.

places.name: Isla's Sizzla de Carinderia
places.summary: Home-cooked meals from a lovely local couple; every reviewer says it tastes like home.

places.name: Edna Eatery
places.address: Tourism Rd, Catangnan side, General Luna
places.summary: Cheap homey carinderia run by Edna herself; half-meat half-veggie plate with rice for around ₱100.

places.name: TP's Food House
places.summary: Simple carinderia locals love; grilled fish steak and crispy pork at true local prices.

places.name: Pore's Restobar / Carenderia
places.summary: Early-opening eatery with evening BBQ; the bas-oy (gingery beef stew) is a hit. Self-service, ~₱100+ per dish.

places.name: Neng's Eatery
places.summary: Beloved family-run eatery a few minutes off the strip; curries, chicken dishes and lots of vegetarian options at ₱100–200 a meal.

places.name: Tuna Road Carenderia
places.summary: Local-favorite lunch buffet packed at noon; the mama running it lets you taste dishes and remembers regulars.

places.name: Siargao Best Barbecue
places.summary: Generous, well-priced BBQ out toward Sta Rosa; buffalo chicken, sinigang and margaritas all praised, sauce not overly sweet.

places.name: Bebie's BBQ
places.summary: Famous local BBQ with a secret sweet sauce you can smell down the road; two dining areas across the street, local prices, waits when busy, mixed takes on the hype.

places.name: Mama's Grill
places.summary: Long-running grill institution: pick fresh skewers (tuna belly, chorizo, squid, eggplant) grilled to order. Big portions, long dinner waits.

places.name: Annattos Barbecue
places.summary: Bacolod-style chicken BBQ loved by locals and visitors alike; affordable, friendly, cash only.

places.name: Catangnan BBQ
places.summary: Cheap quick skewers (inasal, isaw, liver, hotdogs) near Cloud 9; extremely crowded at dinner — double-check your bill.

places.name: LASA Siargao
places.summary: No-frills hole-in-the-wall roastery: lechon baka (coal-roasted beef) with spiced vinegar is the star. Sells out most days — go early.

places.name: Siargao Grill Republiq
places.summary: Fresh sugba-sugba grill near the boardwalk: pork belly, chicken and kinilaw with the ocean breeze, very cheap.

places.name: CEV: Ceviche & Kinilaw Shack
places.summary: Catch-of-the-day ceviche and elevated kinilaw many call the island's best, paired with their own IPA. Al fresco, pet-friendly; book via Instagram.

places.name: Fin & Fin Beach Shack
places.summary: Chef-run seafood shack overlooking Cloud 9: tuna smash burger, wonton tuna nachos and some of the best grilled fish reviewers have had in the country.

places.name: MASA Seafood Bar & Grill
places.summary: Seafood platters, sinigang and frozen margaritas; some rave, others find portions small for the price. Cash only.

places.name: Basilyo Seafoods
places.summary: Local-style seafood house mostly full of Filipinos: garlic butter crab (~₱1,600/kg + cooking fee), kinilaw and salt & pepper squid.

places.name: Abukay Beach House
places.summary: Pricier beachfront seafood kept fresh in live tanks — one of the few on the island with them; kinilaw and tinolang tuna are highlights.

places.name: Isla Cabana Seafood Restaurant
places.address: Inside Isla Cabana Resort, Tourism Rd, General Luna
places.summary: Beachfront resort dining with wave views and big servings; salmon sinigang praised, though some find it a pricey glorified carinderia.

places.name: X Pizza
places.summary: Sourdough pizza, hot-honey fried chicken and margaritas right on the Cloud 9 beachfront with DJ sets — among the island's most-loved pies.

places.name: Supper Supper Pizza & Pasta
places.summary: Neapolitan-style crispy-edged pies from a friendly pizzaiolo; small menu that sometimes runs short of ingredients.

places.name: Bella Crosta
places.summary: Newer family-run pizzeria near Cloud 9 with homemade garlic dip; early reviews call it the best pizza they've had in the Philippines.

places.name: Bulan Pizzeria
places.summary: Barefoot wood-fired pizzeria that also does breakfasts and fresh pastas; quality ingredients, cash only.

places.name: Trattoria Altrove
places.summary: Clay-oven thin-crust pizza (the truffle is a favorite); the menu is now pizza-focused and the dining room dim — great for takeout.

places.name: Amia's Pizza
places.address: Purok 5, near Nissi Christian Academy, General Luna
places.summary: Light doughy crust with quality toppings (burrata, prosciutto); the truffle pie divides opinion, everything else lands.

places.name: Aventino's Pizza
places.summary: Cheap thin-crust standby: the 3-layer pizza has loyal fans, others compare it to frozen pizza — quick, cheap, close by.

places.name: Raku's
places.address: Sta. Fe (north of GL town, R4RQ+453)
places.summary: Underrated NYC-style pizza, lasagna and pasta in Sta. Fe worth the short ride; cash only, ATM nearby.

places.name: Jumak Korean Restaurant
places.summary: Authentic kimchi stew, gimbap and tteokbokki with very generous servings; comfortable room and big parking.

places.name: OPPA Kitchen
places.summary: Korean-fusion favorite: tuna poke bowls, kimchi smash burgers, dakgalbi nachos; hip-hop playlist, rave reviews.

places.name: Nami
places.summary: Small, buzzing Japanese spot with beautifully plated sushi that fills by 7–8 PM; some complaints about service and consistency.

places.name: Drunken Sushi
places.address: Sta. Ines backroad (near Eloida), General Luna
places.summary: Filipino-fusion maki — saucy, generous and fast — at appealing prices, with delivery; posted hours can be unreliable.

places.name: Daluyong Restaurant
places.address: At Daluyong Beach Resort, General Luna
places.summary: Quiet Japanese-leaning resort restaurant with treetop ocean views; cashew chicken and red curry both praised.

places.name: Kimstaurant
places.summary: Unlimited-samgyup Korean grill with budget promos, but repeated complaints about service, sides and authenticity.

places.name: Sai Gao
places.summary: New Asian-fusion spot; very little review data yet.

places.name: Big Belly
places.summary: The island's most-reviewed burger joint: smash burgers, chori fries, milkshakes and free iced tea; order at the counter. A few gripes about patty size for the price.

places.name: Backside Burger
places.summary: Straightforward, huge-portion burgers with a much-loved soft bun and thick-cut fries; the room runs warm.

places.name: Chef Marquin Burgers
places.summary: Giant flame-finished monster burgers with homemade buns; spectacular to look at, mixed on seasoning, slow when busy.

places.name: Subay Burger
places.summary: Hidden-gem burgers around ₱250 with fries and fruit shakes; screens Muay Thai, boxing and UFC fights.

places.name: Guyam's Burger
places.summary: Surprise treat on tiny Guyam Island: soft-bun burgers, cheesy fries and mango-coffee shakes between swims.

places.name: Lost In Siargao
places.summary: Stylish all-day restaurant and beer garden: fresh tuna tartare, schnitzel sandwich, proper cocktails and calmer music than the strip.

places.name: Bànay Bakery + Cafe
places.summary: Pastries, ice cream (real-cheese cheese flavor!) and an after-7PM discounted-bread deal; good wifi.

places.name: Kawayan Gourmand French Bakery
places.summary: French bakery by Cloud 9: chocolatines, cookies and toasties some say beat Manila bakeries; pastries praised, service mixed.

places.name: RAGÙ Deli & Café
places.summary: Deli-cafe with standout coffee, sandwiches, gelato and a famous flourless chocolate cake; power outlets make it work-friendly.

places.name: Chme-istry Café
places.summary: Family-run cake shop and cafe; iced lattes, brownies and custom birthday cakes with delivery.

places.name: Kobe's Bite Dessert House
places.summary: Mom-and-pop dessert shop: halo-halo and the island's best-loved mango float; confirm marked prices before paying — one report of inconsistent quoting.

places.name: Shanti Shanty Café
places.address: West of town center, General Luna
places.summary: Sourdough bakery-cafe with vegan options and homemade nut milks; hammock loft, instruments and spontaneous jam sessions.

places.name: Anju Rinna Pastry & Resto
places.summary: Air-conditioned pastry cafe and resto; croissants and cinnamon rolls good before island-hopping; a few recent service and value complaints.

places.name: Cabuntog Surf Shop & Café
places.summary: Breakfast-and-brunch favorite (banana pancakes, bacon plates) that doubles as a surf-apparel shop; warm staff.

places.name: Miguel's Taqueria
places.summary: Budget taqueria with live bands, horchata and vegetarian options; fish tacos have fans, waits and the cheese sauce have critics.

places.name: El Chapo's
places.summary: Cult-favorite fried beef tacos with salsas visitors call the best they've had, plus horchata to cool the spice.

places.name: Isla Comida
places.summary: Birria specialists — tacos, burritos, fries, ramen, even pizza — with coconut horchata and homemade-tasting shells.

places.name: Cumin
places.summary: Middle-Eastern/Indian fusion: shawarma rice, kebabs and birria-masala tacos on handmade tortillas; card payments accepted, note the 5% service charge.

places.name: Sanabowl Superfood Café
places.summary: Poke and açaí bowls with notably fresh tuna and big portions; seating is cramped and there's no AC.

places.name: The Soul Shack
places.summary: Wellness-minded breakfast bowls and ceremonial cacao in a beautifully curated space; a calm reset from the strip.

places.name: Love Coco Cafe
places.address: Purok 2, General Luna St, General Luna
places.summary: Tiny cafe near the boulevard many call the best smoothie bowls in town; homemade coconut milk and loaded banana bread.

places.name: Outer Cafe
places.summary: Surf-styled brunch spot: soufflé pancakes, sun-dried beef tapa and crispy sisig bites; every breakfast includes a drink.

places.name: Aloha Hostel
places.address: Purok V, Tourism Rd, General Luna
places.summary: Great central location with a shop on site; some rooms are tiny with no AC and there's construction noise nearby — check the room type carefully.

places.name: Happiness Hostel
places.summary: Popular hostel with privacy-curtain dorms, yoga classes, boat trips and a well-loved restaurant; often hosts large tour groups, so the social mix varies.

places.name: Hang Loose Hostel
places.summary: Very cheap open-concept hostel in the middle of the nightlife; twice-weekly parties until 3 AM, strict no-visitors rule; one serious complaint about bike-rental handling.

places.name: Kawayan Hostel
places.summary: Simple budget rooms with an exceptionally helpful owner (laundry, bike hire, luggage storage); some rooms basic on furniture and plumbing.

places.name: Tres Islas Hostel
places.address: Sitio Sta Ines, Pang-pang, General Luna
places.summary: Quiet, friendly hostel with kitchen, stable wifi and board games; thin room walls and humidity are the trade-offs.

places.name: Mantara Hostel
places.summary: Cozy spacious bunk rooms with private baths near Tuason Point; one recent cockroach complaint, others found it clean and homey.

places.name: Higala Hostel
places.summary: Budget rooms near Cloud 9 with kind caretakers and bike rental — but several recent guests report ongoing construction and services not matching listings. Verify current state before booking.

places.name: Dawn Patrol Guesthouse
places.summary: Homely guesthouse run by Wendy and her daughters who treat guests like family; clean, quiet, with billiards and fast wifi.

places.name: Maximum Freediving
places.summary: Beginner-friendly freediving school; Wave 1 courses with video review and patient coaches. One reviewer found sessions photo-heavy.

places.name: OZEN Freediving
places.summary: The island's biggest freediving school (also a hostel); discovery classes through W1/W2 with calm, professional coaches.

places.name: Palaka Siargao Dive Center
places.address: Purok 1, near the market, General Luna
places.summary: Longest-standing scuba center: open-water courses and fun dives in small groups, well-maintained gear, great fish sandwich at the shop.

places.name: Ladin Dive Spot
places.summary: Dive/snorkel spot listing north of town; little data available — ask locally.

places.name: Metrodocs Medical Clinic
places.summary: The go-to 24h clinic in town: fast triage, lab tests, wound care (sea urchins, reef cuts); professional and reassuring, on the pricier side.

places.name: The Raya Clinic
places.address: National Rd, Poblacion IV, General Luna
places.summary: 24/7 clinic with pharmacy, IV fluids and quick lab results; even handled a shoulder relocation. Some complaints about medical-report follow-up.

places.name: Siargao Primary Care Facility
places.summary: Clean clinic with labs and ultrasound near Catangnan; good for consultations, limited for serious injuries.

places.name: General Luna Rural Health Unit
places.summary: The municipal public health unit for basic services and vaccinations.

places.name: Siargao Island Medical Center (Dapa)
places.summary: The island's public hospital in Dapa: cheap X-rays but underfunded and understaffed, with serious complaints about emergency care. For anything major, travelers typically evacuate to Cebu — have insurance sorted.

places.name: Palawan Pawnshop (Money Changer)
places.summary: One of the few reliable money changers in town (even CHF); slow paperwork-heavy process, rates vary by currency — USD fair, EUR weak.

places.name: Cebuana Lhuillier
places.address: San Sebastian St, Poblacion, General Luna
places.summary: Pawnshop branch handy for Remitly and remittance cash pickups; helpful staff and guard.

places.name: M Lhuillier Pawnshop
places.summary: Money transfers and decent USD/EUR exchange rates — bring your passport; picky about worn or older bills.

places.name: Cee Moto Rentals
places.summary: Standout for dirt bikes, scramblers, big bikes and tuk-tuks in top condition; fast WhatsApp booking and impressively handled an accident situation.

places.name: Lola's Rentals
places.summary: Top-rated tuk-tuk and scooter rentals with driving lessons, safety checks and extras (speaker, rain gear, first-aid kit, cooler).

places.name: GoldenBell Motorbike Rental
places.summary: Nearly 900 five-star reviews: well-maintained scooters, surfboard racks available, easy extensions, cafe upstairs. Slightly above average price, worth it.

places.name: Siargao Motorbike Rentals
places.summary: Near-new scooters with airport delivery/pickup and low deposits; one bad report about a worn tire dispute — inspect tires at handover.

places.name: Renta Gao
places.summary: Wide scooter selection at good prices with lessons for beginners; responsive owner Mike, delivery to your stay.

places.name: Morenta Rentals
places.summary: Motorcycle and car rental with delivery/pickup at your stay, fair prices (~₱4,000 for 10 days reported) and famously friendly owners.

places.name: Petron General Luna
places.summary: The main proper gas station in town — much cheaper than roadside bottled fuel, accurate pumps. One reviewer reported uncomfortable behavior from attendants at night.

places.name: Eco-Oil General Luna
places.summary: Small friendly fuel stop on San Sebastian St.

places.name: Fuel Gas Station (Catangnan)
places.summary: Convenient if you're based near Cloud 9, but consistently reported as expensive — fill up at Petron in town instead.

places.name: TAG Minimart
places.address: Tourism Rd, town center, General Luna
places.summary: 24-hour convenience store for essentials; slightly pricey, cash only, bring small bills — they often can't give change.

places.name: Siargao Convenience Store
places.summary: 24-hour corner store on the main strip.

places.name: General Luna Local Market
places.summary: The real local market: fresh fish (morning and ~3–5 PM), fruit, vegetables and coconut milk at far better prices than the minimarts.

places.name: Tag Grocery
places.summary: Cheapest proper grocery in town with some imported items; check expiry dates and expect slow checkout.

places.name: Savers Plus
places.summary: Small convenience store with imported goods (oat milk, nuts, peanut butter); handy but a bit pricey.

places.name: Rena One Stop Shop
places.summary: Small general store for snacks and basics.

places.name: Gasa Souvenir Shop
places.summary: Family shop for tees and boardshorts that also rents surfboards and bikes; Ford doubles as a well-loved surf instructor.

places.name: NOGS Souvenir Shop
places.summary: Cheap keychains, magnets, postcards and Siargao shirts; reviews split between bargain and overpriced depending on the item.

places.name: Langyaw
places.summary: Traveler-run craft shop where you can make your own macramé bracelet (~₱350, 1.5h); jewelry, woodwork and good energy.

places.name: GWAPITOS
places.summary: Boutique-souvenir shop and coffee stand; curated local brands and an iced ube latte worth stopping for. Some note declining shirt quality.

places.name: KS Boardriders Surf Shop
places.address: Tourism Rd / Cloud 9 Dr, General Luna
places.summary: The most complete surf shop on the island — boards (FireWire etc.), wax, leashes, eco swimwear — plus a cafe with coconut cold brew.

places.name: The Whale's Tale
places.summary: Wide-ranging Filipino-made souvenirs — woven bags, shell jewelry, home decor — at fair prices; the shop runs hot and service is hit-or-miss.

places.name: Swell Wash Laundry
places.address: Tourism Rd (opposite Bebie's BBQ), General Luna
places.summary: Central laundry (~₱300/4kg); several reports of shrunk or stained items and slow issue-handling — skip the whites and delicates.

places.name: Siargao Massage Spa
places.summary: Well-reviewed massages with home service to your accommodation, open late.

places.name: Perisseia Spa
places.address: Purok 3, in front of Watsons, General Luna
places.summary: Higher-end spa with skilled therapists and authentic traditional hilot; clean showers and a calm setting.

places.name: Massage Care Spa
places.summary: Small hidden-gem spa; affordable 90-minute massages, fresh linens per client, therapists Gilbert and Roselyn repeatedly praised.

places.name: Celestia Spa and Aesthetics
places.summary: Nails, lashes and aesthetics with same-day WhatsApp bookings and detail-obsessed technicians; cash only.

places.name: OM Spa and Wellness
places.summary: Serene dome-set spa with hilot massage, welcome refreshments and occasional live sound-healing; guests call it magical.

places.name: Vultun Massage Spa
places.summary: Beachfront massages (sometimes with live sunset music drifting in), plus pilates and home service; consistently called the best massage in town.

places.name: Mr. Turtle
places.summary: Stylish lounge-restaurant with excellent cocktails, grilled fish and wifi good enough to work from; turns clubbier on weekend nights.

places.name: La Sola Sunset Bar & Lounge
places.summary: Sunset-facing lounge near the bridge with cocktails, shakes and snacks; walkable, family-friendly, lovely golden hour.

places.name: Surfers Hostel Rooftop Bar
places.summary: Backpacker rooftop with ₱50 rum-cokes, karaoke nights and one of the most social crowds in town.

places.name: Bar Principal
places.summary: Filipino-Cuban craft cocktails, each with a story behind it; polished, intimate and highly rated.

places.name: Sharon's Bar
places.summary: The cheapest cocktails in town (fresh fruit!) plus Filipino-style karaoke, hosted by Sharon herself.

places.name: Strum Music Cafe
places.summary: THE live-music venue: talented local artists nightly, where locals and travelers actually mix.

places.name: El Lobo
places.summary: Loud, packed party bar with DJs — a staple on the island's rotating party schedule; one recent complaint about door staff conduct.

places.name: Siargao Bleu Resort & Spa
places.summary: Established resort with its own quiet beach, floating bungalows and strong breakfast; rooms and spa get mixed reviews.

places.name: Retreat Siargao Resort
places.summary: Spacious spotless rooms on a swimmable Malinao beach, big pool, hands-on owner; ~6 minutes by scooter from town — popular with couples and older travelers.

places.name: Nay Palad Hideaway
places.summary: The island's famous all-inclusive ultra-luxury hideaway: stunning villas, activities and near-telepathic service, at Maldives-level prices.

places.name: Schönhouse Villa
places.summary: Quiet boutique villa two minutes off the main road: beautiful pool, spacious rooms, hefty breakfasts and a beloved host (plus villa dog Charlie).

places.name: INARA Beach Resort
places.summary: Secluded beachfront boutique resort with exceptional staff who arrange boat trips, firefly tours and beach dinners — romantic-getaway territory.

places.name: Villa Cali
places.summary: Big pool, greenery and a Japanese-fusion restaurant near Cloud 9; rooms decent, roosters and drainage the common gripes.

places.name: Munimuni Villas
places.summary: Clean, ergonomic rooms near Cloud 9 with excellent breakfast, backup generator and filtered water; a ride from town.

places.name: Kawayan Villa
places.summary: Two private-feel villas with pool steps from Cloud 9; European-quality restaurant many call among the island's best.

places.name: Payag Suites
places.summary: Spacious rooms near Jacking Horse beach; friendly on-site staff but repeated complaints about refunds and admin responsiveness.

places.name: Ocean 101 Beach Resort
places.summary: One of Siargao's original surf resorts, 2–3 minutes' walk to Cloud 9; unbeatable budget location, aging rooms with mixed maintenance reports.

places.name: Kalinaw Resort
places.summary: Six luxury beachfront villas each with private pool, tablet-ordered service and excellent French-leaning food — a top high-end pick.

places.name: Dormitels PH Cloud 9
places.summary: Budget solo rooms right across from Cloud 9 with laundry service; small rooms, some noise and mustiness.

places.name: Pointbreak Homestay
places.summary: Central homestay with a well-liked pizzeria downstairs; also books island and Sohoton tours.

places.name: Moonlight Homestay
places.summary: Very cheap rooms with breakfast and a caring host (Vivian); expect basic maintenance, thin walls and patchy wifi.

places.name: Budget Siargao Homestay
places.summary: Budget homestay listing in the town center; little review data yet.

places.name: Hostel Bajala
places.summary: Beachfront hostel on Malinao with pristine private rooms, an Indian restaurant, free daily drink and quiet social vibe.

places.name: Angelica's Hostel
places.summary: Clean, quiet Filipino-styled hostel with the Nomad coworking cafe on site; warm family-like staff (Jane and Eddie get constant shoutouts).

places.name: Barrio Francisco Hostel
places.summary: Small quiet hostel with free breakfast, fair scooter rentals and kitchen access; strict no-refund policy on weather cancellations.

places.name: Rich Spirit Yoga
places.summary: Peaceful jungle shala in Sta. Fe run by Des; yoga classes plus acupuncture, beloved by regulars.

places.name: Bodhi Yoga Center
places.summary: Cozy studio overlooking rice fields: Vinyasa, Yin, Yoga Nidra and Tibetan sound baths with experienced teachers.

places.name: Kermit Yoga Shala
places.summary: Beginner-friendly shala at Kermit resort; teacher Tenille repeatedly described as exceptional and non-judgmental.

places.name: Anantha Yoga & Pilates
places.summary: Yoga, acroyoga, pilates and sound healing plus one of the island's better gyms; strong community feel.

places.name: Prana Yoga
places.summary: Beautifully decorated open-air shala inside Prana resort; all-level classes, cacao ceremonies and breathwork, pool and healthy cafe next door.

places.name: Happiness Yoga & Ice Bath
places.summary: Yoga, pilates and ice-bath recovery sessions at Happiness — good post-surf reset.

places.name: Siargao Island Hopping (Market pier)
places.address: By the Local Market pier, General Luna
places.summary: Tri-island and Sohoton bookings from the market pier; responsive on chat, though busy days can mean long boat queues.

places.name: My Siargao Guide
places.summary: Tour operator + surf-skate shop; tri-island tours (~₱1,200 with lunch) that reviewers rank among their best boat trips.

places.name: Siargao Island Tour (Elvis)
places.summary: Consistently 5-star private and joiner tours run by Elvis and team — airport pickups, land tours, island hopping, drone shots included.

places.name: Wow Siargao Travel & Tours
places.summary: Budget tri-island tours (~₱1,299 with lunch and drone footage); well organized, guides less chatty than some.

places.name: GL Siargao Int'l Travel & Tours
places.summary: Private speedboat Sohoton Cove and tri-island tours with boodle-fight lunches; guides Junjun and Joy praised, some timing hiccups.

places.name: Travel Essentials Siargao
places.summary: Well-reviewed operator for Siargao and Surigao mainland trips (Enchanted River, Sohoton); organized, family-style guiding.

places.name: Love Beach
places.summary: Small free beach pocket by the beach club with volleyball; pretty and quiet, best at higher tide.

places.name: Mahaybo Beach
places.summary: Postcard hidden beach with exfoliating-fine sand, shade trees, sea stars and great sunsets; rough dirt access road, keep valuables close.

places.name: Naked Island
places.summary: A bare white sandbar in open ocean — the classic tri-island stop with Daku and Guyam. Zero shade: bring sunscreen, water and sunglasses.

places.name: Alegria Beach (north-island day trip)
places.address: Santa Monica, northern tip of Siargao
places.summary: Often called the island's best swimming beach — sandy bottom, swimmable at any tide; a scenic ride from GL through villages.

places.name: Taktak Falls (north-island day trip)
places.summary: Siargao's only waterfall: ~15 m cascade into a swimmable basin with a tree jump; small entrance and parking fees; combine with Alegria/Pacifico.

places.name: Siargao Rose Bike & Car Rental
places.summary: Top-rated airport-based rental — scooters, enduros, tuk-tuks, 7-seaters — grab your ride the minute you land; excellent rates and communication.

places.name: Siargao Van Transfer
places.summary: Van transfer service based in town; call to book airport runs.

places.name: Siargao (Sayak) Airport
places.address: Del Carmen, ~45 min from General Luna
places.summary: The island's small airport, currently expanding: ₱20 environmental fee on arrival and departure, hot pre-departure area, limited food — arrive early but expect basic.

places.name: Euronet ATM (Mad Monkey)
places.summary: 24h Euronet machine at Mad Monkey; one report of a failed dispense that still debited — keep receipts and monitor your account.

places.name: Euronet ATM (Yolly's Inn, Tourism Rd)
places.summary: Central 24h ATM (₱10,000 limit); works with most cards including Revolut — always DECLINE its conversion rate and use your bank's.

places.name: Siargao Sunflower Suites
places.summary: Spacious, quiet suites 2 minutes' ride off the main road; comfy beds and helpful staff, though in-room wifi is weak — the garden common area has the signal.

places.name: Marco Suites
places.summary: Affordable modern rooms right on Tourism Rd; second-floor rooms run hot with undersized AC.

places.name: Siargao Suites
places.summary: Newer suites property on Tourism Rd; little review data yet.

places.name: Puyo Suites
places.summary: Value-for-money suites in the center with terraces and stable wifi; note the strict no-refund cancellation policy.

places.name: EME's Apartelle
places.summary: Spacious budget apartelle near Tourism Rd; bring your own toiletries.

places.name: YAMA Apartments
places.summary: Private beachfront apartments with swimmable water and lovely staff; some bar noise until midnight.

places.name: Villa Pura Vida Apartments
places.summary: Beautifully curated apartments with full kitchens (espresso machine included), pool and standout hosts — great for longer stays.

places.name: Puraw Lofts
places.summary: Quiet fully-equipped lofts near the market built for long stays and remote work; fast internet.

places.name: GMV Apartment
places.summary: Clean kitchenette apartments in the heart of town — bank, pharmacy, market and cafes all within a block.

places.name: Sing Siargao
places.summary: Modern quiet apartments in Malinao with Starlink + generator — a remote-worker favorite near Secret Beach; strict on weather cancellations.

places.name: Seagrass Apartments
places.summary: Spacious full-kitchen apartments run by a friendly family, with a secret path to the beach; great value.

places.name: Rucksack Inn
places.summary: The island's biggest hostel: pool, afternoon volleyball, restaurant and 24h coworking (WaveWork); social without being a party hostel.

places.name: Green Room.Inn
places.summary: Budget rooms with hot showers, cable TV and a backup generator; one ant infestation report handled fairly by the owner.

places.name: Edward Patrecia Pension House
places.summary: Group-friendly pension house in the center; spacious and cheap, but water pressure and AC struggle at full occupancy.

places.name: Shanti's Inn
places.summary: Family-run budget rooms on a quiet backstreet in the middle of the nightlife zone; no generator, so brownouts mean no power or water.

places.name: Tropico Inn
places.summary: Well-located travelers' inn with spacious rooms and massage service; shared bathrooms are the weak point.

places.name: Tahanan Homestay
places.address: Old Tourism Rd, Purok 5, General Luna
places.summary: Homestay with pool, self-service kitchen and a host (Rod) who arranges tours, scooters and transfers; strict 7-day refund rule.

places.name: Siargao Serene Guest House
places.summary: Small couple-sized homestay with full kitchen, hot water and gated parking.

places.name: Foxtail Guest House
places.summary: Central guest house with pool and fast wifi (40–50 Mbps) at a good price; power reliability complaints during outages.

places.name: Sharegao Guesthouse
places.summary: Beloved guesthouse near Cloud 9 where host Sonia organizes dinners, snorkeling and firefly tours; access path gets muddy in rain.

places.name: OHANA Guesthouse
places.summary: Affordable, clean homestay with a fully equipped shared kitchen; local-tourist friendly pricing.

places.name: Yaho Homestay
places.summary: Listed for completeness: 1.7★ with repeated complaints about the owner's conduct, mold and pricing — look elsewhere first.

places.name: Casa Felipe Guesthouse
places.summary: Minimalist, spotless budget guesthouse with a hands-on manager and entrance guard; many call it the best homestay in town.

places.name: Ayman's Guest House
places.summary: Spacious rooms each with private bath, family-style hospitality and breakfast; very affordable.

places.name: Siargao Books Cafe
places.summary: The 24/7 cafe: AC indoor room, borrowable books, card payments — the late-night work and study spot.

places.name: Amon Cafe
places.summary: Tiny brunch cafe with a cult following: tapa benedict, mushrooms on toast, baristas who remember your order.

places.name: Coffee Stroll
places.summary: Manually pressed, obsessively crafted coffee with seasonal beans; dogs to pet, chess to play, superb cookies.

places.name: Big Mama Café
places.summary: Green-field views, pool table, excellent flat whites and shakshuka; artsy surfer vibe from the After Surf Carinderia crew.

places.name: Hmm Matcha
places.summary: Late-night matcha bar many call the island's best, with killer cookies and handmade ceramics for sale.

places.name: Matchiargao
places.summary: All-pink matcha shop by Cloud 9: ube matcha and coconut matcha are the signatures.

places.name: Seijaku Coffee & Matcha
places.address: Purple House, Tourism Rd, General Luna
places.summary: Ghibli-styled coffee-and-matcha bar with adjustable sweetness and hojicha and Thai-tea blends; a matcha lover's pilgrimage.

places.name: The Clean Bean
places.summary: Cozy backroad corner cafe with an ube latte, tofu sisig rice and reliable internet for remote work.

places.name: Saint Thomas Coffee
places.summary: Specialty coffee tucked in a jungle-y spot off Old Tourism Rd, with rooftop sofas, lavender lattes and homemade pastries.

places.name: Sunday Siargao (Cafe & Pool)
places.summary: Japanese-leaning cafe-restaurant with a clean pool you can use as a guest; 50/50 coffee and salmon rolls praised; card-only above ₱1,000.

places.name: Coco Cafe (Libertad)
places.summary: Garden cafe with rooftop sunset views next to Coco Space in Libertad; fresh food and work-friendly seating.

places.name: Gaya Rooftop Space
places.address: Lexias Hostel rooftop, Tourism Rd, Catangnan
places.summary: Peaceful rooftop cafe with veggie-friendly bowls, borrowable books and what regulars call the best barista coffee around.

places.name: Coco Space Coworking
places.summary: The island's flagship coworking: solid wifi, pool, sunset views and a genuine community with weekly events.

places.name: Lungga Coworking & Coliving
places.summary: Eco-brutalist coworking + coliving + cafe on Starlink and solar — untouched by island power outages; pool and meeting booths.

places.name: WaveWork Co-Working (Rucksack)
places.summary: 24h coworking inside Rucksack Inn: fast wifi, generator backup, call rooms and a digital-nomad crowd.

places.name: Ink Digger Tattoo
places.summary: Top-rated tattoo studio known for patience with revisions, affordable 'surprise tattoo' picks and clean setup.

places.name: Irie Tattoo & Piercing
places.summary: The most-reviewed studio on the island — fine-line ocean-themed work (whale sharks, tuna) that reviewers rave about.

places.name: Sweet Pain Tattoo Studio
places.summary: Clean modern studio strong on delicate fine-line work with soft shading; fair upfront pricing.

places.name: Inkfocus Tattoo & Piercing
places.summary: Hygienic studio with several talented artists (Stephen, Mike, Patrick) sharing a cohesive island style; reasonable prices.

places.name: Abaii Tattoo & Piercing
places.summary: Fun 24h studio with bucket-draw surprise tattoos, strong realism artists and negotiable pricing.

places.name: Haoma Barber Studio
places.summary: The most reliable cut in town per regulars — handles afro hair well, affordable, unhurried.

places.name: Baduyan Kultyur Barber
places.address: San Vicente cor Clarin St, near Cloud 9
places.summary: One-of-a-kind beachside barber experience with KD, a styling perfectionist with his own product line; allow 1–2 hours.

places.name: JC WOW Barber Shop (Town)
places.summary: Solid fades and beard work (~₱500); good with foreign hair types.

places.name: JC WOW Barbershop (Cloud 9)
places.summary: Cloud 9 branch with skilled fades and a mini massage after; confirm the price before the cut — quotes have drifted between ₱300–500.

places.name: CDR Expert Barber Shop
places.summary: Cheap local cuts (~₱200) with wildly mixed reviews — fine for a simple trim, skip the hair coloring.

places.name: PrimeFit Gym (Town)
places.summary: The main open-air gym in town: full equipment, protein bar with shakes and burritos, towels and water refills included.

places.name: PrimeFit Performance (Sta Ines)
places.summary: Functional-training and Hyrox-style branch with classes, breakfast and shakes; lighter on bodybuilding machines.

places.name: SurFit Gym
places.summary: Complete, well-maintained gym (even an air runner and rower) with surf-strength coaching and affordable passes.

places.name: Eskapo Fitness
places.summary: Open-air gym with good machines and vibe; ₱300–350 day pass, no showers or towels.

places.name: Tawhay Fitness
places.summary: Jungle-set holistic gym: classes (Evolve, pilates, yoga), sauna and ice-bath recovery, coconuts at the counter — weekly passes are great value.

places.name: Ding King Surfboard Repair
places.summary: THE board-repair guys (Chester & co): dings, delams and paint jobs fixed fast and seamlessly at fair prices.

places.name: Siargao Surfboard Trader
places.address: Casa de Loren, Poblacion 5, General Luna
places.summary: Buy new and used boards (ECS and more) with genuinely helpful sizing advice from Ross; also surfskates.

places.name: Fat Lips Surfshop
places.summary: The classic long-term board-rental shop: huge quiver, unlimited board swaps during your rental, no-fuss leash replacements.

places.name: Cloud 9 Skatepark
places.summary: Free community skatepark with halfpipe and ramps; boards and pads can be borrowed, evening instructors available.

places.name: Sto. Tomas de Villanueva Parish Church
places.summary: The town's surprisingly grand parish church with a choir visitors rave about; English mass Sundays 8:30 AM.

places.name: Dapa Ferry Terminal
places.summary: Gateway ferry port to Surigao City: fast ferry ~90 min (~₱300–350), slow RORO ~3.5 h (from ~₱100; Montenegro preferred for vehicles); expect terminal + environmental fees and pushy tricycle quotes — fair GL fare is ~₱150–300, not ₱500.

places.name: Kanijogan Water Refilling Station
places.summary: Purified-water refilling station on Malinao Rd for long-stayers refilling 5-gallon jugs.

places.name: Surfing Drone Guy (choyakzchoy)
places.summary: Kuya Choy shoots your surf sessions by drone and camera at Cloud 9 — cinematic results, coaches your posing too.

places.name: Siargao Buddy (Tours & Photo)
places.summary: Guide Kim runs north/south land tours doubling as photo shoots with drone shots included; treats guests like friends.

places.name: Arean Keith Cinematography
places.summary: Local photographer/videographer for family and travel shoots; delivers all edited photos, not just selects.

places.name: JLQ Hardware
places.summary: Hardware and building materials near the port.

places.name: CBS Hardware
places.summary: Small but packed hardware shop on Tourism Rd with fast delivery — if you need it, they probably have it.

places.name: Copacabana Boutique Hotel + Artcafé
places.hours: Front desk hours vary; cafe daytime
places.summary: Boutique hotel whose artcafé (ube cloud latte, tuna tataki, basque cheesecake) is a destination in itself; roosters and ongoing construction are the noise gripes.

places.name: Siargao Bed and Brew
places.summary: Hotel + microbrewery with the much-praised Cloud 9 burger; light sleepers beware — courtyard parties have run past 3 AM.

places.name: Bulkan Villas Rental
places.summary: Quiet villa rental near the skatepark with hands-on hosts.

places.name: Privada Villa
places.summary: Private-pool villas with kitchenettes near Cloud 9; pools cleaned daily, showers warm rather than hot.

places.name: Lubunacos VillaLuna
places.summary: Spotless pool villa run by the cheerful Luna, who also organizes small-group island-hopping trips; acai bowls by the pool.

places.name: Angelito's Beach House
places.summary: Beachfront rooms on a quiet white-sand stretch with car and scooter rental on site.

places.name: Sunset Beach House (Sta Fe, 3BR)
places.summary: Whole-house three-bedroom rental on the Sta. Fe sunset side.

places.name: Romantic Beach Villas
places.summary: Family-friendly beachfront resort in the heart of town: two pools, reef snorkeling off the sand, Thai/European restaurant.

places.name: Flo Island Home
places.address: Quiet street off center, General Luna
places.summary: Basic budget rooms with usable kitchen 10 minutes' walk from Tourism Rd; maintenance is hit-and-miss.

places.name: Secret Spot Eco-Homestay
places.address: Tourism Rd near the port, General Luna
places.summary: Stylish, pet-friendly eco-homestay with standout service (and a lobby cat), 5 minutes from the restaurant strip.

places.name: Diwa Siargao
places.summary: Immaculate eco-house rooms with free breakfast, earplugs and eye masks provided — a serene budget pick between town and Malinao.

places.name: Kamurayaw Homestay
places.summary: Quiet homestay with shared kitchen, pool table and resident cats/dogs; strict cancellation policy even for typhoons.

places.name: DRB Room Apartments
places.summary: Cheap family units with yard, kitchen utensils and fridge; some pest complaints — inspect before committing.

places.name: Hidden Grove Guest House
places.summary: Spotless budget rooms 1 km off the main road with welcome bakery treats and unlimited drinking water — top value.

places.name: Luna Tres Homestay
places.summary: Gated pool homestay right in the center — rooms open onto the pool; bike rental and hot showers.

places.name: Katana Private Residence
places.summary: Long-stay deluxe rooms with kitchenette, shared kitchen and chill 'tambayan'; recurring mold complaints in some rooms.

places.name: Yayay Homestay
places.summary: Spacious Malinao rooms with kitchenette and fridge, walking distance to snorkel beaches; pack mosquito repellent.

places.name: Good Cup (ex-Kahatea)
places.summary: Vegan-friendly boba stand with generous, affordable milk teas — brown sugar and strawberry-matcha are favorites.

places.name: Ahavah Milk Tea
places.summary: Little Catangnan milk-tea stand with fun flavors and honest pricing away from the main-strip noise.

places.name: NATAD Street Food
places.summary: Cluster of authentic street-food stalls with transparent local prices — clean, cheap and genuinely local.

places.name: Siargao Hawker
places.summary: Singaporean hawker stall by Jacking Horse — beef rendang and hainan chicken with a resident husky; dinner only.

places.name: Isla Turon Deluxe
places.summary: Gourmet giant-turon stall: crème-brûlée caramel, Belgian chocolate, ube — one easily feeds a group.

places.name: Jorene's Homemade Ice Cream
places.summary: Family garage turned halo-halo parlor — homemade ube ice cream many call the island's best; mini burgers on the side.

places.name: Gib's Halo Halo (Pilar day trip)
places.hours: Daytime; call out 'ayo!' at the house
places.summary: Hidden home stall in Pilar serving what locals call the island's best halo-halo, loaded with fresh fruit and ube ice cream.

places.name: Halika Siargao
places.summary: Beloved gelato spot — salted caramel Oreo, ube cheese, mango float and a lemon–blue-pea 'Siargao' flavor.

places.name: MUJO Ice Bath
places.summary: Guided ice baths with breathwork coaching plus fresh ginger 'power shots' — the island's recovery ritual.

places.name: All About Cocoo
places.summary: Air-conditioned coconut dessert bar: snow-fine shaved ice (jack & ube!), coconut coffee with mini cocoroons.

places.name: Bugnaw Froyo
places.summary: Frozen yogurt open till midnight with free Jenga at every table — the after-party dessert stop.

places.name: Yogi Yogurt House
places.summary: Homemade froyo house near Cloud 9 with a vegan coconut-milk base and build-your-own toppings.

places.name: COCO FRÍO
places.summary: Hole-in-the-wall coconut coffee (the ca phe sua and affogato are legendary) served in real coconut shells — go early, they sell out.

places.name: Vinta Alternative Market
places.summary: Beautifully curated eco-boutique: swimwear, jewelry, bulk nuts and teas, natural body care — the best souvenir stop in town.

places.name: Puregold (Siargao Town Center, Dapa)
places.address: Siargao Town Center, Dapa (~25 min from GL)
places.summary: The island's biggest supermarket, in Dapa: full grocery run with card/GCash accepted — budget time for the long checkout queues.

places.name: Irevamp Gadget Repair
places.summary: Fast, fairly priced phone repairs (batteries, water damage) right on Tourism Rd.

places.name: COEG 7 Electronics & Repair
places.summary: Skilled gadget techs (phones, charge ports, even CCTV installs) known to work past closing to finish a job.

places.name: Comeg Seven Mobile & Repair
places.address: Tourism Rd, beside Siargao Beach Club
places.summary: The island's go-to for serious electronics surgery: drones, MacBooks, water-damaged iPhones — honest diagnostics.

places.name: The Phone Hospital
places.summary: 'Dr. Gonzalez' fixes phones and laptops fast at honest prices, and even helps with insurance claim paperwork.

places.name: Isla Dentista Dental Clinic
places.summary: Modern, clean dental clinic (Doc Ayds) handling everything from cleanings to emergency toothaches.

places.name: Eyog Dental Clinic
places.summary: Professional, transparent dental care by the plaza — gentle work praised by locals and foreigners alike.

places.name: VetCare Animal Clinic
places.summary: Caring vet clinic (Doc Tin) that also stocks pet food and supplies; known for helping rescued strays.

places.name: Siargao Pet Doctors
places.summary: Vet clinic and adoption hub; good-hearted routine care, though major surgery still means a mainland trip.

places.name: LBC Express (Dapa)
places.address: Near Dapa port (~30 min from GL)
places.summary: Nearest LBC courier branch, by Dapa port; cash only and deliveries to the island run slow — allow extra days.

places.name: Siargao Wakepark
places.summary: Cable wakeboarding park with beginner-friendly coaches, obstacle features, food and drinks — one of the island's top-rated activities.

places.name: Catangnan Beach
places.summary: Underrated yellow-sand swimming beach near the bridge — clear water, no rocks, chill local vibe.

places.name: Gen. Luna Municipal Hall
places.summary: The municipal hall for permits, taxes and local government business — classic Philippine civic architecture.

places.name: 5J's1E Printshop
places.summary: Printing and copying shop next to the bank row.

places.name: Island Prints Siargao
places.summary: Print shop for documents, photos and merch printing.

places.name: Centerpoint Internet Cafe
places.summary: Basic internet cafe for printing, copies and passport photos; fine for simple jobs.

places.name: Pesangan SurfCamp
places.summary: Simple garden cabins at fair prices with friendly local staff; dead central, so expect bar, road and construction noise — bring earplugs.

places.name: Villa Pagoda
places.summary: Beachfront villa rooms with full kitchen, hot shower and a seaside pagoda to sit under; quiet despite being steps from Tourism Rd, but no breakfast and patchy wifi.

places.name: Matanjak Guesthouse
places.summary: Big, spotless rooms on a calm stretch of Tourism Rd with motorbike rental on site.

places.name: Alpas Siargao
places.summary: Beautiful, peaceful private rooms right beside the main strip — among the best private-room options in town; wifi is weak and shared showers run hot-only.

places.name: Mao Mao Surf
places.summary: A-frame bungalows around a pool with excellent breakfast and a serious surf program — coaching plus drone video analysis you get to keep.

places.name: Isla Burger
places.summary: Cheap 24-hour burger counter on the strip — handy after a late night.

places.name: Al's Beach Pizza
places.summary: Thin-crust pizza and fresh grilled tuna with tables right on the sand along the Jacking Horse trail.

places.name: Salami Karajaw
places.summary: Crisp-based Italian pizza and pasta with Italian deli meats, plus gelato and mango slushies; the zozzona and spicy honey get the loudest praise.

places.name: Siaruko Bread Station
places.summary: Tiny bakery selling warm sweet and savory buns straight from the oven at genuinely local prices.

places.name: Kambal Pandesal
places.hours: Early mornings — often sold out by 9 AM
places.summary: Fresh pandesal from about ₱3 plus filled buns — adobo, spicy tuna, ham and cheese, pan de coco. Get there early.

places.name: Meraki Bakery (Pacifico day trip)
places.summary: Cinnamon rolls and sesame-olive-oil lattes people ride an hour north for; pair it with an Alegria or Pacifico day.

places.name: Hotto Bōru
places.summary: Japanese beef bowls and noodles served until 4 AM — one of the very few kitchens open till dawn.

places.name: Noods Wok Bar
places.summary: Busy Asian wok and ramen bar; the bao buns and dumplings outshine the ramen, and waits can be long.

places.name: Buonana
places.summary: Vegan banana ice-cream bowls in coconut shells topped with granola and homemade peanut butter — which they also sell by the jar.

places.name: Ver De Siargao
places.address: Alon Cloud9 Resort, Tourism Rd, Catangnan
places.summary: Plant-forward all-day kitchen near Cloud 9 with plenty of outlets and free wifi — a solid work-and-eat spot.

places.name: Nanay Fely's Seafood and Grill
places.summary: Upstairs grill above the nightlife strip: cheap Filipino breakfasts, kinilaw, liempo and garlic shrimp with live bands below.

places.name: VAN Surf Camp
places.summary: Patient beginner lessons from Van and his instructors, with hotel pickup and easy WhatsApp booking.

places.name: Ulap Surf
places.summary: Locally owned school led by Ana Mae — women's retreats, video analysis, meditation and land drills alongside the water time.

places.name: Siargao Surf Academy
places.summary: Jun's team arranges boards, boats, drone footage and spot selection; roughly ₱2,500 for a private two-hour class.

places.name: Silver Wave Laundry
places.summary: Same-day laundry with free pickup and delivery to your accommodation, and unusually good communication.

places.name: Clean Queen Siargao
places.summary: Fast same-day washing near Cloud 9; count your items on drop-off — mix-ups are a recurring complaint.

places.name: Suurf and Suds Laundry
places.summary: Good stain removal and neat folding at fair prices; a few reports of whites coming back discolored.

places.name: Ken Laundry Shop
places.summary: Quick, cheap wash (around ₱300 for 7 kg) plus shoe cleaning, out in Malinao.

places.name: Gubby's Laundry
places.summary: Small neighborhood laundry near the market.

places.name: Isla Natura Spa
places.summary: The most consistently recommended massage in town — spotless, calm and therapists who actually apply pressure.

places.name: Marina Nails & Lashes
places.summary: Gel work that reportedly lasts weeks, plus the island's best-reviewed lash lift, out in Libertad.

places.name: Amore Beauty Lounge
places.summary: Home-based nail studio doing meticulous BIAB and nail art — survives surfing, by several accounts.

places.name: Mawi Tawi Nail & Lashes
places.summary: Neat, hygienic nail art at affordable prices with a fun studio atmosphere.

places.name: The Island Aesthetics
places.summary: Nails, lashes, brows and hair in one studio near Cloud 9; book through Instagram.

places.name: KUBO Concept Store
places.address: Beside Noods Wok Bar, Tourism Rd
places.summary: Curated bikini and surf-apparel boutique with genuinely helpful fitting advice.

places.name: Beach Republic Bikinis
places.summary: Island branch of a Manila swimwear label — unique prints and fabric that holds up in the surf.

places.name: Dawn & Dusk Boutique
places.summary: Bohemian womenswear, handmade bags and accessories — a good gift stop, mostly women's pieces.

places.name: Tropa Store
places.summary: Air-conditioned boutique stocking Filipino designers; premium prices, and their online orders draw complaints — buy in person.

places.name: Patrick's Souvenir & Siargao Delicacies
places.summary: Souvenirs, fashion and local pasalubong delicacies in one small shop.

places.name: General Luna Central Elementary School
places.summary: The town's public elementary school, beside the plaza and covered court.

places.name: Island of Siargao Learning Academy
places.summary: Private learning academy toward Malinao.
